name: Red Hat Section Divider
description: Section divider slide from the Red Hat corporate template. Uses inherited background from the template deck. Contains a large title and a section marker.
usage_notes: The background is inherited from the template layout/master. When duplicating into a non-template deck, set a solid red background: rgb(0.8, 0.11, 0.11) or use the deck's existing divider as a base.
Best approach: Copy one divider slide manually from the template into the target deck (keeps background/branding). Then duplicate that slide programmatically for additional sections.
The Slides API cannot transfer stretchedPictureFill background images across presentations — even from copies you own. Always use the 'copy manually, then duplicate via API' pattern.

title.description: Main section title — large white text, left-aligned

section_marker.description: Small section marker text — top-left, white

workflow.step1: Manually copy a divider slide from the Red Hat template (1nv_haj_O-miYUbNcFt3JgRF7e9FodNvRXjxjmpd7LLM) into the target presentation. This preserves the branded background pattern.
workflow.step2: Update text on the manually copied slide using deleteText + insertText API calls.
workflow.step3: Use duplicateObject to create additional divider slides from the first one.
workflow.step4: Move duplicates into correct positions with updateSlidesPosition.
workflow.step5: Update text on each duplicate with the correct section title and number.
